Step-by-step diagram of transverse binary fission in Paramecium in five stages from left to right: (1) a full-grown slipper-shaped Paramecium with cilia, an oral groove, a large bean-shaped macronucleus, a small round micronucleus beside it and two star-shaped contractile vacuoles; (2) the micronucleus dividing into two and the macronucleus elongating; (3) a constriction forming across the middle of the cell, with each half receiving a micronucleus and half of the macronucleus; (4) the constriction deepening; (5) two small daughter Paramecia separating.
